author: kanagu
content:
Its a great match of Power tennis Harsh.. I really loved it... Roger got the nerves and he prevailed... you could have sensed that in the last 2 or 3 serves of Roddick... Federer tried to break him but Roddick didn't came near to break Roger's serve.. there are lot of aces from Roger at crucial times... But Roddick was the better player today... lost his serve only one time in the whole match and that proved to be decisive one
Federer wasn't at his best in the final ... He made a lot of unforced errors ... luckily he managed to raise his game at crucial stages ... i.e when he was 2-6 down in the second set facing 4 set points and when he was 15-40 down on his own serve in final set facing 2 break points .... thats a sign of a great player ... cool under pressure !!
